data.text:
Simulated lab alert: Rack A inlet 4.7C high and rising (~0.5C/10min), return air also rising, power normal. All sensors trusted (none flat).

Diagnosis: AC cooling degrading with posterior 1.0, onset ~54 min ago. Hidden rack B estimated 33.2C, only 1.8C below its 35C simulated limit. Breach plausible within ~48 min if nothing done.

Action tested: backup cooling to rackA vs shed load. Backup cooling reduced breach risk 0.28 to 0 and gave -2.2C margin vs -1.0C. Requested switch_backup_cooling rackA - approved by human, takes effect in 20 min.

This supplements, never replaces, real alarms and wiring checks.
